thesis: Euronet Worldwide, Inc. memiliki fundamental cukup (skor 58/100) dengan keunggulan utama di valuasi (96) dan kualitas bisnis (47). Titik lemahnya ada di pertumbuhan (37). Gabungan model DCF, multiple sektor, dan target analis menghasilkan nilai wajar $117.90 — potensi naik 66.0% dalam ~12 bulan (keyakinan rendah). Kondisi teknikal cukup (56/100). Risiko geopolitik rendah.

cons.text: Lonjakan laba sangat besar (+92%) — bila bisnisnya siklikal, P/E rendah di puncak siklus bisa menyesatkan; proyeksi berisiko terlalu optimistis.
Altman Z-Score 1.8 — berada di zona rawan tekanan keuangan.
Short interest 16.2% dari float — banyak investor bertaruh harga turun.
Estimasi nilai wajar antar-metode berbeda jauh — ketidakpastian proyeksi tinggi.

pros.text: P/E forward 6.1x — 65% lebih murah dari median sektor Teknologi (17.4x).
Free cash flow yield 16.6%: setiap $100 nilai saham menghasilkan $16.6 kas bebas per tahun ($434 jt).
Laba per saham (EPS) diproyeksikan naik 92% — dari $6.05 ke $11.63.
Estimasi nilai wajar $117.90 vs harga $71.04 — potensi naik 66% (rentang $66–$135).
PEG ratio 0.10 — pertumbuhan laba belum sepenuhnya tercermin di harga (GARP: Growth at Reasonable Price).
Piotroski F-Score 7/9 — fundamental membaik di hampir semua indikator (laba, arus kas, leverage, efisiensi).

summary: Euronet Worldwide, Inc. provides payment and transaction processing and distribution solutions to financial institutions, retailers, service providers, and individual consumers internationally. The company operates through three segments: Electronic Funds Transfer (EFT), epay, and Money Transfer. The EFT segment provides automated teller machine cash withdrawal and deposit services, ATM network participation, outsourced ATM and point-of-sale (POS) management solutions, credit and debit and prepaid card outsourcing, card issuing, and merchant acquiring services.
